title: Prannoy hints Aichi-Nagoya is his last Asian Games, eyes LA 2028 Olympics
indian_angle: This story provides insight into the future plans of one of India's top male shuttlers regarding major international tournaments.
summary: HS Prannoy, a former world No. 6, has indicated that the ongoing Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya will likely be his last, though he hasn't ruled out competing in the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics if he remains competitive.

title: Indian men and women shuttlers likely to face Japan in Asian Games quarters
indian_angle: Indian badminton fans will be keen to know the potential path of their national teams in the prestigious Asian Games.
summary: The draws for the Asian Games badminton event suggest that both the Indian men's and women's teams are likely to encounter strong Japanese opposition in the quarter-final stages after initial matches against Kazakhstan and Bangladesh respectively.

title: Final Selection Trials for BWF World Junior Championships 2026 announced
indian_angle: This notification is crucial for young Indian talents aspiring to represent the country at the global junior championships in Cairo.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has released the player eligibility criteria and the list of qualified players for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026, to be held in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is vital for preparing India's next generation of badminton stars for continental competition.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, focusing on preparing young talents.

title: BAI implements 3x15 scoring system in junior domestic tournaments
indian_angle: This significant rule change will impact how junior badminton is played and developed across India in U-13, U-15, and U-17 categories.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships across the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course held in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course is crucial for enhancing the coaching standards and development of badminton talent across India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) is conducting a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.
